consequence.statement: The memory leak that could occur in Envoy when using HTTPS in slow request scenarios such as high packet loss networks is now fixed; no operator action is required in response to this fix.

original.statement: A memory leak in Envoy that could occur when using HTTPS in slow request scenarios such as high packet loss networks has been fixed.

decision.reason: [ev-c0fcac29e341] describes this only as a fix for a possible Envoy memory leak when HTTPS is used with slow requests, such as on networks with high packet loss. It says nothing about anything failing, being rejected or no longer being honoured, and no operator step is required. After the upgrade, an exposed environment simply gets the fix, so "none" (informational) is the right consequence.
